name: claude-ghost
description: Inline ghost-text completions powered by the local Claude CLI.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Claude Ghost spawns the local `claude` CLI; settings that control the binary path or CLI arguments are ignored in untrusted workspaces.

enumDescriptions: Latest Haiku — fastest, cheapest. Recommended for inline completion.
Latest Sonnet — balanced quality and latency.
Latest Opus — most capable, slowest, most expensive.
claude-ghost.model.description: Claude model family. Resolves to the latest model in that family. To pin a specific version, type its full ID (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6) directly in settings.json.

claude-ghost.contextLines.description: Fallback context window (lines before and after cursor) when the file exceeds contextMaxBytes.

claude-ghost.contextMaxBytes.description: Byte threshold. Files below this are sent whole; above it, only ±contextLines are sent.

claude-ghost.claudePath.description: Path to the Claude CLI binary.

claude-ghost.bare.description: Pass --bare to the Claude CLI. Reduces startup cost but requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or apiKeyHelper; leave false for OAuth-authenticated installs.

claude-ghost.effort.description: Effort level (--effort). Only reduces thinking budget; use disableThinking to skip thinking entirely.

claude-ghost.disableThinking.description: Set CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_THINKING=1 on the Claude child process. Overrides the global settings.json `alwaysThinkingEnabled` and skips extended thinking entirely — needed for inline-completion latency.

claude-ghost.maxChars.description: Maximum characters per completion. Interrupts the CLI once exceeded. Set to -1 for no cap (default).

claude-ghost.autoTrigger.description: Automatically request a completion after a pause in typing. Disabled by default — use the manual trigger keybinding instead.

claude-ghost.maximalist.description: Enable maximalist mode (experimental). Unlocks the `Claude Ghost: Trigger Maximalist` command, which reads a nearby source comment (e.g. '// create a class for managing a user crud system') and generates a complete in-file implementation with integration comments. One-file scope. Works best with model=sonnet or opus and maxChars=-1.

claude-ghost.maximalistFreshSession.description: Restart the Claude session before each maximalist trigger so prior completion turns don't bias the prompt. Adds ~2–5s of restart latency but keeps every maximalist run on a clean context.

claude-ghost.autoTriggerDelayMs.description: Idle-typing delay in milliseconds before an auto-trigger fires. Only used when autoTrigger is enabled.

claude-ghost.localMetrics.description: Opt in to writing a per-completion JSONL log at ~/.claude-ghost/metrics.jsonl. No upload; for your own `jq` analysis.
